name: Zenit
description: Uruguayan store of luggage, backpacks, bags, handbags, wallets, travel accessories, thermoses and mate gear, apparel and sunglasses. Ships to the whole country and offers free pickup at its Montevideo stores.
description_es: Tienda uruguaya de valijas, mochilas, bolsos, carteras, billeteras, accesorios de viaje, termos y materas, vestimenta y lentes de sol. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro sin costo en sus locales de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide delivery within up to 4 business days after payment confirmation; free shipping over a purchase threshold, per the store's shipping page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at its Montevideo stores, ready within up to 4 business days.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.
